name: @mediajel/assistant-core
description: The Integrations Assistant's framework-free half: the page recorder and its eleven sources, in-page verification, the prompt and its knowledge base, the step machine, masking and size policy. No UI, no storage, no network — the extension supplies all three.
//exports: Raw TS, compiled by the consuming app (same contract as tracker-core). The extension bundles it with esbuild via Plasmo; there is no build step here.

scripts.//test: happy-dom is registered from the preload so the browser-only modules under test import unchanged; `bun test` exits 1 when it finds no test files.
